<thought>From the ESI spectrum the base peak is at m/z 121.0528, which is most likely the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.0073 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈120.0455 Da. The formula C₄H₈O₄ has a calculated monoisotopic mass of 120.0423 Da, within a few ppm of the observed value and fits the observed isotopic pattern (M+1 intensity ≈ 8 % from four carbons). No other common elements are indicated, so the molecular formula is C₄H₈O₄.</thought>
<final_answer>C4H8O4</final_answer>
